clues: This city is in eastern Spain, in the region of Aragon. It serves as the capital of its province.
The temperature here swings a lot in one day. Warm afternoons can give way to cold nights, so the weather feels harsh.
Moorish skill shaped many fine buildings here long ago. Their shared style is now prized as world heritage.
This place felt so forgotten that in 1999 its people launched a campaign. Its bold message was simply: we exist.
Rocks near this town hold dinosaur bones. They are among the oldest ever found on this whole peninsula.
